title: Nvidia to sell 1 million chips to Amazon by end of 2027 in cloud deal
title_zh: 英伟达将在 2027 年底之前通过云交易向亚马逊出售 100 万块芯片
summary: Nvidia will sell 1 million of its graphics processing unit chips, along with a host of ‌the AI giant's other offerings, to Amazon.com's cloud computing unit by 2027, ‌a Nvidia executive told Reuters on Thursday.
summary_zh: Nvidia 的一位高管周四告诉路透社，到 2027 年，Nvidia 将向亚马逊的云计算部门出售 100 万个图形处理单元芯片，以及该人工智能巨头的许多其他产品。

title: DNOW Faces ERP Turbulence And Legal Questions After MRC Global Deal
title_zh: MRC Global 交易后，DNOW 面临 ERP 动荡和法律问题
summary: DNOW (NYSE:DNOW) is working through material integration challenges tied to its MRC Global acquisition, with Oracle ERP issues affecting roughly 40% of its U.S. operations.
summary_zh: DNOW（纽约证券交易所股票代码：DNOW）正在解决与其 MRC Global 收购相关的材料集成挑战，Oracle ERP 问题影响了其约 40% 的美国业务。

title: Ecolab Nears Deal for KKR’s Data-Center Cooling Company
title_zh: 艺康 (Ecolab) 即将收购 KKR 数据中心冷却公司
summary: Ecolab  is nearing a deal to acquire data-center cooling company CoolIT Systems from  KKR  for between $4.5 billion and $5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Ecolab 即将达成协议，以 45 亿至 50 亿美元的价格从 KKR 手中收购数据中心冷却公司 CoolIT Systems。

title: Why Companies Are Chopping Up Big Bond Deals Into Smaller Pieces
title_zh: 为什么公司将大型债券交易分割成较小的部分
summary: The average number of tranches on investment-grade bond deals is at a record high as companies issue jumbo deals and look for cost savings.
summary_zh: 随着公司发行巨额交易并寻求节省成本，投资级债券交易的平均批次数量创下历史新高。

title: Is KKR’s (KKR) Deal Juggling Amid Liquidity Strains Reframing Its Private Markets Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 在流动性紧张的情况下进行的交易是否正在重新制定其私募市场策略？
summary: In recent days, KKR has reportedly joined the bidding for Pacific Equity Partners-owned UP Education, which could fetch more than A$1.00 billion, while also exploring a potential sale of liquid-cooling provider CoolIT Systems in a deal that may exceed US$3.00 billion.
summary_zh: 据报道，最近几天，KKR 加入了对 Pacific Equity Partners 旗下的 UP Education 的竞购，该交易的售价可能超过 10 亿澳元，同时还在探索出售液冷供应商 CoolIT Systems 的可能性，交易金额可能超过 30 亿美元。
